source_summary: Muted ink-and-wash winter riverside landscape with bare trees, low village structures, shrubs, reeds, water, birds, and foreground fences; upper field is largely open atmosphere with no calligraphy or seals included.

motifs.name: central_leafless_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the tall central winter tree with multiple dark trunks rising from exposed roots, a dense web of fine bare branches spreading upward and outward, and faint adjacent twig clusters that belong to the same tree mass.
must_preserve: subtle ink wash variations along trunks

motifs.name: left_slope_bare_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the large bare tree growing from the left hillside, including its angled trunk, forked limbs, delicate leafless twigs, and the sloping bank immediately supporting its roots.

motifs.name: right_willow_like_bare_tree
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side leafless tree with a sweeping low trunk and upward-arching branches, including its sparse fine twigs and the darker branching base near the riverbank.

motifs.name: village_roofs_on_left_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the cluster of low village roofs and small structures at the lower left, set into the bank below the trees, including roof planes, posts, wall outlines, and the small descending path or steps.

motifs.name: leafy_shrub_cluster
motifs.description: Isolate the dense cluster of shrubs and small leafy trees in front of the village, with mottled foliage dots and short branch strokes at the lower center-left.
must_preserve: varied dark and pale ink spots

motifs.name: reed_bank_and_river_wash
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side riverbank with dense reeds and grasses along the edge, plus the adjacent calm water surface indicated by horizontal ink washes.

motifs.name: foreground_fence_and_grasses
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground fenced patch near the bottom center, including thin fence posts, woven rails, upright grasses, and the surrounding small earth mound.

motifs.name: two_flying_birds
motifs.description: Isolate the two small dark birds flying in the open air to the right of the central trees, preserving their compact silhouettes and wing positions without surrounding blank field beyond the necessary margin.
must_preserve: small separation between the two birds

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
